e.title: **同一门课的两种形态，以及「答案在到期前不出来」的机制**：索邦大学 **M2 Actuariat** 气候风险课程材料——**五讲 × 两小时**，**每讲同时提供**学生版**（`SessionX_compact.pdf`）**与**演示版**（`SessionX_extended.pdf`，**逐条揭示、**新出现的那条高亮**）；**⭐⭐⭐ 而它的作业答案被**加密后提交进仓库**，**由一条每 5 分钟运行的 GitHub Action **到期自动解密发布**；**⭐ 参考文献里有**IAIS 的 AI 与气候监管文件**与**NGFS 情景****
e.title_en: One course in two forms, plus a mechanism for keeping answers out of sight until they are due: climate risk materials for a Master 2 Actuarial Science programme at Sorbonne University, five two-hour sessions each published in a student version and a presentation version whose bullets are revealed one at a time with the newest highlighted, and coursework answers stored encrypted in the repository and decrypted and published automatically at their due time by a GitHub Action that runs every five minutes, with a reading list that includes the insurance supervisors climate guidance and the central banks climate scenarios.
e.title_hk: **同一門課的兩種形態，以及「答案在到期前不出來」的機制**：索邦大學 **M2 Actuariat** 氣候風險課程材料——**五講 × 兩小時**，**每講同時提供**學生版**與**演示版**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而它的作業答案被**加密後提交進倉庫**，**由一條每 5 分鐘運行的 GitHub Action **到期自動解密發布**；**⭐ 參考文獻裡有**IAIS 的氣候監管文件**與**NGFS 情景****
e.summary: **sorbonne-climate-risks**（`Vermandel/sorbonne-climate-risks`）**是索邦大学 **M2 Actuariat（精算硕士）**「气候风险」课程的**转型风险**部分材料**（**逐字为**「**cinq séances de deux heures**」**，**作者** Gauthier Vermandel**）**，**逐字说明它讲的是**「**la chaîne qui relie les politiques climatiques et l’activité économique aux émissions, à la température, aux entreprises, aux actifs financiers et aux décisions d’assurance**」。**本条目属于本轮主题**「同源多形」**，**它在两端都给样本**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 同一门课、两种形态**——**每讲逐字提供两种**同步**格式**：`SessionX_compact.pdf` **为**« la version de référence destinée aux étudiant·es »**，`SessionX_extended.pdf` **为演示版并逐字说明**「**Ses puces sont révélées une à une et la puce nouvellement révélée est mise en évidence**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 答案在到期前不出现在仓库里**——**这套机制逐字叫**「**Publication synchronisée des corrigés（PSC）**」：**每个未来的答案以**加密形式**保存**（`publication/encrypted/*.ipynb.gpg`**）**，**由一条 GitHub Action 在**`publication/releases.json` 里指定的时刻**解密并发布**；**⭐ 工作流实测**每 5 分钟跑一次**（`cron: "*/5 * * * *"`**）**，**清单里逐字给出时区** `Europe/Paris` **与** `lead_minutes: 15`**；**⭐⭐ ③ 教学材料里点名了**读情景的正确姿势**——**逐字**「**Interpréter les scénarios comme des trajectoires conditionnelles plutôt que comme des prévisions ou des probabilités**」**；**⭐⭐ ④ 参考文献是一份**精算监管向书单****（**含** GIEC AR6、**NGFS 2024、**TCFD 2017、**IAIS 2021 关于气候相关风险监管的应用文件、**Nordhaus 2017 社会碳成本、**McNeil／Frey／Embrechts 2015**）**。**⚠️ 本次未运行任何 notebook、**未读任何 PDF、**未解密任何答案**（**私钥只在 GitHub secret 里**）**。
e.summary_hk: **sorbonne-climate-risks**（`Vermandel/sorbonne-climate-risks`）**是索邦大學 **M2 Actuariat（精算碩士）**「氣候風險」課程的**轉型風險**部分材料**（**逐字為**「**cinq séances de deux heures**」**）**，**逐字說明它講的是**「**la chaîne qui relie les politiques climatiques et l’activité économique aux émissions, à la température, aux entreprises, aux actifs financiers et aux décisions d’assurance**」。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「同源多形」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 同一門課、兩種形態**——**每講逐字提供兩種**同步**格式**（`SessionX_compact.pdf` **為學生版參考**；`SessionX_extended.pdf` **為演示版**，**逐字**「**Ses puces sont révélées une à une et la puce nouvellement révélée est mise en évidence**」**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 答案在到期前不出現在倉庫裡**——**機制逐字叫**「**Publication synchronisée des corrigés（PSC）**」：**答案以**加密形式**保存**（`publication/encrypted/*.ipynb.gpg`**）**，**由 GitHub Action 在**`publication/releases.json` 指定的時刻**解密並發布**；**工作流每 5 分鐘跑一次**（`cron: "*/5 * * * *"`**）**，**清單逐字給出時區** `Europe/Paris` **與** `lead_minutes: 15`**；**⭐⭐ ③ 逐字教讀情景的正確姿勢**（**「**Interpréter les scénarios comme des trajectoires conditionnelles plutôt que comme des prévisions ou des probabilités**」**）**；**⭐⭐ ④ 參考文獻是一份**精算監管向書單****（**GIEC AR6、NGFS 2024、TCFD 2017、IAIS 2021、Nordhaus 2017、McNeil／Frey／Embrechts 2015**）**。**⚠️ 本次未運行任何 notebook、未讀任何 PDF、未解密任何答案**。
e.summary_en: The repository `Vermandel/sorbonne-climate-risks` **holds the transition risk materials for a climate risk course in a Master 2 actuarial programme at Sorbonne University**, five two-hour sessions taught and written by Gauthier Vermandel, and described verbatim as developing the chain that links climate policy and economic activity to emissions, temperature, firms, financial assets and insurance decisions. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one source taking several forms, and it provides a sample at both ends**: **every session ships in two synchronised formats**, a compact reference version for students and a presentation version whose bullets are revealed one at a time with the newly revealed bullet highlighted; **and coursework answers do not exist in plaintext in the repository before they are due**, since each future correction is stored encrypted and a GitHub Action decrypts and publishes it at the time named in a manifest, a mechanism the README calls synchronised publication of corrections, running on a schedule every five minutes with the timezone and a fifteen-minute lead recorded in the manifest. **The materials also state the correct way to read scenarios**, verbatim, as conditional trajectories rather than forecasts or probabilities, **and the reading list is an actuarial supervision list**, including the latest IPCC report, the central banks climate scenarios, the task force on climate-related financial disclosures, the international association of insurance supervisors application paper on the supervision of climate-related risks, the social cost of carbon, and a standard quantitative risk management textbook. **No notebook was run, no PDF was read and no correction was decrypted this round.**
e.body:
**sorbonne-climate-risks**（仓库 `Vermandel/sorbonne-climate-risks`）**是索邦大学 **M2 Actuariat**（**精算硕士**）「**Risques climatiques**（**气候风险**）」课程中**转型风险**部分的材料**，**逐字自述为**「**Ce dépôt contient le volet consacré au risque de transition de Gauthier Vermandel : cinq séances de deux heures.**」**，**并逐字说明这条链**：**「**Il développe la chaîne qui relie les politiques climatiques et l’activité économique aux émissions, à la température, aux entreprises, aux actifs financiers et aux décisions d’assurance.**」**。**本次实测**：**★1**、**创建 2026-08-21**、**最后推送 2026-09-09**、**主语言标注为 Jupyter Notebook**、**README 实测 5,532 字节**、**文件清单实测 61 条**（**15 个目录、46 个文件**）；**⚠️ 仓库内未见 `LICENSE`**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**同源多形：一份内容、好几种形态，且必须对得上**」**；**本词条认为它是四条里唯一一条把**时间**也当成一种形态的**——**同一份答案，在到期前与到期后是两种状态**。

**可核实信息（均 README、文件清单、工作流、清单 JSON 与依赖文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 同一门课，每讲两种形态，且说明了两者的分工**——**README 逐字**：**「**Chaque séance est disponible dans deux formats synchronisés : `SessionX_compact.pdf` est la version de référence destinée aux étudiant·es. La page du cours renvoie directement vers ce format. `SessionX_extended.pdf` est la version de présentation. Ses puces sont révélées une à une et la puce nouvellement révélée est mise en évidence.**」**，**并逐讲给出两组链接**（**Séance 1 到 Séance 5**）**。**⭐ 即**同一份内容**有两种**同步**呈现**（**一为阅读、一为讲授**），**且哪一种是**给学生**的**被明确写出来**——**⭐ 而这也解释了为什么需要**两个 PDF**：**演示版的逐条揭示**在静态阅读里反而是缺点**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 作业答案以**加密态**存在，**到期才变成明文****——README 有专节，**标题逐字为**「**Publication synchronisée des corrigés (PSC)**」**，**并逐字说明**：**「**La procédure PSC conserve chaque futur corrigé sous forme chiffrée, puis une GitHub Action le déchiffre et le publie à la date indiquée dans `publication/releases.json`. Elle s’exécute toutes les cinq minutes et peut aussi être lancée manuellement depuis l’onglet Actions.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 本次实测到该机制的**四处细节**：**① **清单文件**`publication/releases.json`（**1,266 字节**）**逐字给出** `"timezone": "Europe/Paris"` **与** `"lead_minutes": 15`，**并列出 6 条发布项**，**每条含** `id`、**ISO-8601 带时区的** `release_at`、**加密源路径** `encrypted` **与**目标路径 `target`（**如** `2026-09-02T10:15:00+02:00` **对应** `publication/encrypted/TP1_corrige.ipynb.gpg` **→** `Session1/correction/TP1_corrige.ipynb`**）**；**② **工作流**`.github/workflows/publish-corrections.yml`（**1,149 字节**）**逐字含** `cron: "*/5 * * * *"` **与** `workflow_dispatch`、**权限** `permissions: contents: write`、**并发组** `group: publish-corrections` **且** `cancel-in-progress: false`；**③ 步骤逐字为**：**检出 → 从 GitHub secret `PSC_PRIVATE_KEY` 导入私钥（**并在导入前先跑一条** `test -n "$PSC_PRIVATE_KEY"` **确认非空**）→ 运行** `python3 scripts/publish_due_corrections.py` **→ 若输出** `published == ‘true’` **则由机器人身份** `github-actions[bot]` **提交并推送**；**④ 仓库里只放**公钥**（`publication/psc-public-key.asc`）**，**README 逐字**「**La clé privée n’est présente que dans le secret GitHub `PSC_PRIVATE_KEY`.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处工程做法**：**「**答案在到期前不许出现**」如果只靠约定，**迟早会有人手滑推上去**；**它把这个约定**变成了一条可执行的检查**——**答案在仓库里**存在但不可读**，**发布是一条**定时任务**，**而**明文只在到期后出现**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ README 还给出**准备一份新答案的四步**，**且第二步要求时间写成**带时区的 ISO-8601****——**逐字**：「**1. le chiffrer avec `scripts/prepare_correction.sh path/to/solution.ipynb publication/encrypted/solution.ipynb.gpg`；2. ajouter au manifeste son identifiant, son heure ISO-8601 avec fuseau, le chemin chiffré et le chemin public cible；3. versionner uniquement l’archive `.gpg`, le manifeste et la page du cours — jamais le corrigé en clair avant l’échéance；4. donner au bouton du site la classe `psc-correction` et un attribut `data-release-at` contenant exactement la même heure.**」**。**⭐ 即**第 4 步把**网页按钮**也绑到同一个时间上**（**属性值与清单里的时间必须完全相同**）——**⭐ 即**「**同一个时刻**」在**三个地方**出现：**清单、**按钮属性、**实际发布**；**⭐ 本词条如实标注**：**本次**未核实这三处实际是否一致**（**未读网页端代码**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 材料本身对「情景」这个词给了正确的读法**——**课程目标逐字含**：**「**Interpréter les scénarios comme des trajectoires conditionnelles plutôt que comme des prévisions ou des probabilités**」**，**另一条逐字为**「**Discuter les implications et les limites des scénarios de transition issus de modèles pour l’analyse des risques actuariels et financiers**」**——**⭐ 即**它明确要求学生**不要把情景当成预测**——**⭐ 这与本站 [[ngfs]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]] 等条目里反复出现的同一类提醒同向**：**情景是条件路径，不是概率分布**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 教学内容是可数的、且自带数据与代码**——**五讲逐字为**：**① 一体化评估模型的经济学基础；② 排放、浓度与温度；③ 气候情景与 DICE；④ 参数不确定性；⑤ 最优气候政策与社会碳成本**；**文件清单实测含**12 个 notebook**（**每讲的 `TPx_sujet.ipynb` 与 `correction/TPx_corrige.ipynb`，**第 3／5 讲另有** `TP3_basics` **与** `TP5_bonus`**）**、**11 个 PDF**（**每讲两份**＋**syllabus**）**、**4 个 CSV**（**含** `data/SSP_scenarios.csv`、`data/ngfs_scenarios.csv`、`data/temperature_historique.csv` **与一份 SSP 数据**）**、**代码文件** `OptimalGrowth.py`、`climate_models.py`、**各讲的** `DICE.py`**、**6 个加密答案** `.gpg`**、**以及** `requirements.txt`（**逐字含** `numpy>=1.24`、`pandas>=1.5`、`matplotlib>=3.6`、`scipy>=1.10`、`jupyter>=1.0`、`nbconvert>=7.0`、`tqdm>=4.64`、`numba>=0.58`、`requests>=2.28`**）**。**⭐ 即**DICE 与简化的气候模型**是**在这个仓库里可运行的东西**，**而不是只出现在幻灯片上**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 参考文献是一份「精算监管向」书单**——README 的 Références 一节逐字列出：**GIEC (2021) AR6 Working Group I**、**GIEC (2023) AR6 Synthesis Report**、**NGFS (2024) Climate Scenarios for Central Banks and Supervisors**、**O’Neill et al. (2017) The roads ahead: Narratives for shared socioeconomic pathways**、**Nordhaus (2017) Revisiting the social cost of carbon**、**TCFD (2017) Recommendations of the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures**、**IAIS (2021) Application Paper on the Supervision of Climate-related Risks**、**McNeil, Frey et Embrechts (2015) Quantitative Risk Management**。**⭐ 即**一门**精算硕士**课程的阅读清单里同时有**气候科学（IPCC）、**央行与监管情景（NGFS、TCFD、IAIS）**与**精算标准教材**（**McNeil 等**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 还有一条容易被忽略的教学纪律**——**README 逐字**：**「**Ne créez, ne versionnez et ne synchronisez jamais d’environnement virtuel dans ce dépôt pédagogique : `.venv/`, `venv/` et `env/` sont exclus par `.gitignore`.**」**，**并要求把环境建在**Dropbox 目录之外**。**⭐ 即**「**不要把虚拟环境提交进教学仓库**」**也被写成一条明文要求**。**⚠️ 本次实测两处**缺失**（**只记录、不推测原因**）**：**① **仓库内未见 `LICENSE`**（**故本词条不主张许可状态，按惯例记作**权利不明****）；**② **本次未在清单里看到课程网站的源码**，**而 README 第 4 步提到**「**la page du cours**」**的按钮与属性**（**即**网页端可能不在此仓库**）。**⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[ngfs]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]]、[[catmodeling]] 覆盖气候情景数据的来源与建模**，**[[insurance-pricing-course]]、[[cas-python-workshop]]、[[ldacourse1]]、[[juliaactuary-learn]] 覆盖**精算教学材料**这一形态**，**而本条补上的是**「**一门硕士课程如何把**练习、答案与数据**放在同一个仓库里，并让答案在到期前不可读**」这一组合**；**其转型风险链条与** [[open-source-economic-model]] **的资产负债建模取向相邻，但用途不同**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[ngfs]]、[[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]] 应当并读**——**它给的是一份**可直接对照的精算硕士气候风险课程样本**（**五讲大纲、**每讲的 notebook 与数据、**DICE 实现、**以及一份监管向阅读清单**）；**⭐ 而它对本词条项目自身最有借鉴的一点是**：**把「**什么时候可以公开**」做成机制**，**而不是靠自觉**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行任何 notebook、没有安装任何依赖、没有解密任何答案**（**未执行 `prepare_correction.sh` 或 `publish_due_corrections.py`、**未触碰任何 `.gpg`、**未访问任何 PDF 或幻灯片**）**，**故不主张**课程内容、模型实现、情景数据或教学效果**按所述成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 PDF 与任何 notebook 正文**——**本次只读了** `README.md`（5,532 字节）、**文件清单**、`.github/workflows/publish-corrections.yml`（1,149 字节）、`publication/releases.json`（1,266 字节）、`requirements.txt`（118 字节）**与** `scripts/publish_due_corrections.py` **的文件大小**，**故不主张** DICE 与 `climate_models.py` 的实现方式、notebook 的练习内容、**以及** `publish_due_corrections.py` **判定到期的具体逻辑**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实发布机制是否真的按时间触发过**：**本次未查该仓库的 Actions 运行历史、**未核实那 6 条发布项的实际状态、**也未核实「**第 4 步**」要求的**按钮属性**是否与清单一致**（**未读网页端代码**）。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `lead_minutes: 15` **这个提前量的用途**（**本次只读到该字段存在**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实课程的实际开课情况**（**未访问课程页、**未核实该 volet 是否为完整课程的一部分**——**README 逐字称它是**「**le volet consacré au risque de transition**」**，**即**完整课程中的一个部分**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与院系关系**（**本次只读到 README 自述的姓名与单位**）；**★1 不构成质量证据**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可未主张**：**仓库内未见 `LICENSE`**——**按惯例记作**权利不明**，**不是「无版权」**；**⚠️ 故其中的 PDF 与 notebook **不宜再分发**，**本词条只作描述与链接**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2026-08-21 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**把定时解密发布用于教学答案、并把同一门课做成同步的两种形态**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用法文原文时，把原文里的 ASCII 撇号（如 `l’activité`、`d’assurance`、`O’Neill`）写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。

**sorbonne-climate-risks**（倉庫 `Vermandel/sorbonne-climate-risks`）**是索邦大學 **M2 Actuariat**（**精算碩士**）「**Risques climatiques**（**氣候風險**）」課程中**轉型風險**部分的材料**，**逐字自述為**「**Ce dépôt contient le volet consacré au risque de transition de Gauthier Vermandel : cinq séances de deux heures.**」**，**並逐字說明這條鏈**：**「**Il développe la chaîne qui relie les politiques climatiques et l’activité économique aux émissions, à la température, aux entreprises, aux actifs financiers et aux décisions d’assurance.**」**。**本次實測**：**★1**、**建立 2026-08-21**、**最後推送 2026-09-09**、**主語言標注為 Jupyter Notebook**、**README 實測 5,532 位元組**、**文件清單實測 61 條**（**15 個目錄、46 個檔案**）；**⚠️ 倉庫內未見 `LICENSE`**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**同源多形**」**；**本詞條認為它是四條裡唯一一條把**時間**也當成一種形態的**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、文件清單、工作流、清單 JSON 與依賴檔實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 同一門課，每講兩種形態**——**逐字**：**「**Chaque séance est disponible dans deux formats synchronisés : `SessionX_compact.pdf` est la version de référence destinée aux étudiant·es. La page du cours renvoie directement vers ce format. `SessionX_extended.pdf` est la version de présentation. Ses puces sont révélées une à une et la puce nouvellement révélée est mise en évidence.**」**。**⭐ 即**同一份內容有兩種**同步**呈現**（**一為閱讀、一為講授**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 作業答案以**加密態**存在，**到期才變成明文****——**專節標題逐字為**「**Publication synchronisée des corrigés (PSC)**」**，**並逐字**「**La procédure PSC conserve chaque futur corrigé sous forme chiffrée, puis une GitHub Action le déchiffre et le publie à la date indiquée dans `publication/releases.json`. Elle s’exécute toutes les cinq minutes.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 本次實測到四處細節**：**① **清單** `publication/releases.json`（1,266 位元組）**逐字含** `"timezone": "Europe/Paris"` **與** `"lead_minutes": 15`，**並列出 6 條發布項**（**每條含** `id`、**ISO-8601 帶時區的** `release_at`、**加密源** `encrypted` **與**目標 `target`**）**；**② **工作流**（1,149 位元組）**逐字含** `cron: "*/5 * * * *"`、`workflow_dispatch`、`permissions: contents: write`、**併發組** `publish-corrections` **且** `cancel-in-progress: false`；**③ 步驟逐字為**：**檢出 → 從 secret `PSC_PRIVATE_KEY` 匯入私鑰（**先跑** `test -n "$PSC_PRIVATE_KEY"`**）→ 執行** `python3 scripts/publish_due_corrections.py` **→ 若** `published == ‘true’` **則由** `github-actions[bot]` **提交並推送**；**④ 倉庫裡只放**公鑰**，**私鑰逐字只在 GitHub secret 裡**。**⭐ 即**「**答案在到期前不許出現**」**若只靠約定**遲早會有人手滑**，**而這裡把它變成一條**可執行的檢查**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ README 給出**準備新答案的四步****——**逐字**「**1. le chiffrer avec `scripts/prepare_correction.sh path/to/solution.ipynb publication/encrypted/solution.ipynb.gpg`；2. ajouter au manifeste son identifiant, son heure ISO-8601 avec fuseau, le chemin chiffré et le chemin public cible；3. versionner uniquement l’archive `.gpg`, le manifeste et la page du cours — jamais le corrigé en clair avant l’échéance；4. donner au bouton du site la classe `psc-correction` et un attribut `data-release-at` contenant exactement la même heure.**」**——**⭐ 即**同一個時刻在**三處**出現（**清單、**按鈕屬性、**實際發布**）**；**⚠️ 本次未核實三處實際是否一致**。**⭐⭐ ④ 材料對「情景」給了正確讀法**——**逐字**：**「**Interpréter les scénarios comme des trajectoires conditionnelles plutôt que comme des prévisions ou des probabilités**」**——**⭐ 即**它明確要求學生**不要把情景當成預測**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 教學內容可數且自帶資料與程式碼**——**五講逐字為**：**一體化評估模型的經濟學基礎、**排放濃度與溫度、**氣候情景與 DICE、**參數不確定性、**最優氣候政策與社會碳成本**；**清單實測含**12 個 notebook**、**11 個 PDF**、**4 個 CSV**（**含** `data/SSP_scenarios.csv`、`data/ngfs_scenarios.csv`、`data/temperature_historique.csv`**）**、**代碼檔** `OptimalGrowth.py`、`climate_models.py`、**各講的** `DICE.py`**、**6 個加密答案** `.gpg` **與** `requirements.txt`**。**⭐ 即**DICE 與簡化氣候模型**是**在這個倉庫裡可執行的東西**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 參考文獻是一份「精算監管向」書單**——**逐字列出** GIEC AR6（2021／2023）、NGFS（2024）、O’Neill et al.（2017）、Nordhaus（2017）、TCFD（2017）、**IAIS（2021）Application Paper on the Supervision of Climate-related Risks**、McNeil／Frey／Embrechts（2015）。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 一條教學紀律**——**逐字**：**「**Ne créez, ne versionnez et ne synchronisez jamais d’environnement virtuel dans ce dépôt pédagogique**」**，**並要求把環境建在**Dropbox 目錄之外**。**⚠️ 本次實測兩處**缺失**（**只記錄、不推測原因**）**：**① **未見 `LICENSE`**（**按慣例記作**權利不明****）；**② **清單裡未見課程網站原始碼**，**而第 4 步提到網頁按鈕**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[ngfs]]、[[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是一份**可直接對照的精算碩士氣候風險課程樣本**；**⭐ 而它對本詞條專案最有借鑑的一點是**：**把「**什麼時候可以公開**」做成機制**，**而不是靠自覺**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行任何 notebook、沒有安裝任何依賴、沒有解密任何答案**，**故不主張**課程內容、模型實作、情景資料或教學效果**按所述成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何 PDF 與任何 notebook 正文**——**只讀了** `README.md`、**文件清單**、`.github/workflows/publish-corrections.yml`、`publication/releases.json`、`requirements.txt` **與** `scripts/publish_due_corrections.py` **的檔案大小**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實發布機制是否真的按時間觸發過**（**未查 Actions 執行歷史、未核實 6 條發布項狀態、未核實按鈕屬性是否與清單一致**）。**④ ⚠️ 未核實** `lead_minutes: 15` **的用途**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實課程的實際開課情況**（**README 逐字稱它是**「**le volet consacré au risque de transition**」**，**即**完整課程中的一部分**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份與院系關係**；**★1 不構成品質證據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 許可未主張**：**未見 `LICENSE`**——**記作**權利不明**，**不是「無版權」**；**其中 PDF 與 notebook 不宜再分發，本詞條只作描述與連結**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2026-08-21 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「把定時解密發布用於教學答案、並把同一門課做成同步的兩種形態」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用法文原文時，把原文裡的 ASCII 撇號（`l’activité`、`d’assurance`、`O’Neill`）寫作 ’**——**以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**。

The repository `Vermandel/sorbonne-climate-risks` **holds the transition risk portion of a climate risk course in the Master 2 actuarial programme at Sorbonne University**, described verbatim as five two-hour sessions that develop the chain linking climate policy and economic activity to emissions, temperature, firms, financial assets and insurance decisions. **Measured this round**: **one star**, **created 2026-08-21**, **last pushed 2026-09-09**, **primary language recorded as Jupyter Notebook**, **the README measuring 5,532 bytes**, **the file listing measuring sixty-one entries across fifteen directories and forty-six files**, and **no licence file present**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one source taking several forms and of those forms having to agree, and it is the only one of the four that treats time itself as one of the forms.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the file listing, the workflow, the release manifest and the dependency file**: **first, each session ships in two synchronised forms, and which one is for whom is stated.** The README says verbatim that each session is available in two synchronised formats, that the compact file is the reference version for students and is the format the course page links to directly, and that the extended file is the presentation version whose bullets are revealed one at a time with the newly revealed bullet highlighted, followed by two links per session. **The same content therefore has two synchronised presentations, one for reading and one for teaching, and which one students should use is written out** — which also explains why two files are needed at all, since progressive reveal is a defect in static reading. **Second, coursework answers exist in encrypted form and only become plaintext when due.** A dedicated section, titled synchronised publication of corrections, states verbatim that the procedure keeps each future correction in encrypted form and that a GitHub Action decrypts and publishes it at the date given in the release manifest, running every five minutes and also launchable manually. **Four details of that mechanism were measured**: the manifest, measuring 1,266 bytes, names the timezone and a fifteen-minute lead, and lists six releases each carrying an identifier, an ISO-8601 timestamp with an offset, an encrypted source path and a target path; the workflow, measuring 1,149 bytes, runs on a five-minute cron and on manual dispatch, declares write permission for contents, and uses a concurrency group that does not cancel in progress; the steps import the private key from a repository secret after first asserting that the secret is non-empty, run the publishing script, and if the script reports that something was published, commit and push as the automation bot; and only the public key is committed, with the README stating verbatim that the private key exists only in the repository secret. **Enforcing that answers must not appear before they are due by convention alone eventually fails when somebody pushes the wrong file; here the convention becomes an executable check, because the answers exist in the repository but are unreadable, publication is a scheduled job, and plaintext appears only after the due time.** **Third, the README gives four steps for preparing a future correction and requires the time to be written as ISO-8601 with a timezone**: encrypt the notebook with the provided script; add to the manifest its identifier, its ISO-8601 time with offset, the encrypted path and the target public path; commit only the encrypted archive, the manifest and the course page, never the cleartext correction before the deadline; and give the site button a specific class and a release attribute containing exactly the same time. **The same instant therefore appears in three places: the manifest, the button attribute and the actual publication, although whether those three agree in practice was not verified, since the page code was not read.** **Fourth, the materials state the correct way to read a scenario**, verbatim, as interpreting scenarios as conditional trajectories rather than forecasts or probabilities, with a second objective about discussing the implications and limits of model-derived transition scenarios for actuarial and financial risk analysis, **which aligns with the same reminder that recurs across the pooled climate scenario and catastrophe entries: a scenario is a conditional path, not a probability distribution.** **Fifth, the teaching content is countable and comes with its own data and code**: five sessions on the economics of integrated assessment models, emissions and temperature, climate scenarios and DICE, parameter uncertainty, and optimal climate policy and the social cost of carbon; and the file listing holds twelve notebooks, eleven PDFs, four CSV files including shared socio-economic pathway scenarios, central bank climate scenarios and historical temperature data, three Python modules including the DICE implementation and a climate model per session, six encrypted corrections, and a requirements file pinning numpy, pandas, matplotlib, scipy, jupyter, nbconvert, tqdm, numba and requests. **DICE and the simplified climate models are therefore runnable artefacts in this repository rather than slides alone.** **Sixth, the reading list is an actuarial supervision list**: the latest IPCC working group one report and its synthesis report, the central banks climate scenarios, the task force on climate-related financial disclosures recommendations, the international association of insurance supervisors application paper on the supervision of climate-related risks, the social cost of carbon, the shared socio-economic pathway narratives and a standard quantitative risk management textbook. **Seventh, an easily missed teaching rule is also written down**: never create, version or synchronise a virtual environment in this teaching repository, with the environment directories excluded by the ignore file and the environment instructed to be created outside a cloud-synced folder. **Two absences were measured and are recorded without speculation about cause**: there is no licence file, so no licence status is claimed and the rights are recorded as unclear rather than as absent copyright; and the course page source does not appear in the listing although the fourth preparation step refers to a site button, so the page may live elsewhere. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled climate scenario, catastrophe and data entries cover where climate data comes from and how it is modelled, and the pooled teaching entries cover actuarial teaching materials, while this entry supplies the combination of exercises, answers and data in one repository with the answers unreadable until due; its transition risk chain is adjacent to the pooled open-source economic model entry in spirit but serves a different purpose.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[ngfs]] and [[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]]**, because **it is a directly comparable sample of an actuarial master course on climate risk**, with a five-session outline, notebooks and data per session, a DICE implementation and a supervision-oriented reading list; **and the practice most transferable to this wiki is turning when something may be published into a mechanism rather than relying on discipline**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no notebook was run, no dependency was installed and no correction was decrypted** — no preparation or publishing script was executed, no encrypted archive was touched and no PDF or slide deck was opened — **so the course content, the model implementations, the scenario data and the teaching outcome are not claimed to hold as described**. **Second, no PDF and no notebook body was read**: only the README, the file listing, the workflow, the release manifest, the requirements file and the size of the publishing script were read, **so nothing is claimed about how DICE and the climate model are implemented, what the exercises contain, or the exact logic by which the publishing script decides something is due; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the publication mechanism has actually fired on schedule was not verified**: the repository action history was not checked, the status of those six releases was not checked, and whether the site button attribute matches the manifest was not checked because the page code was not read. **Fourth, the purpose of the fifteen-minute lead was not established**, only that the field exists. **Fifth, whether the course actually runs was not verified**, the course page was not visited, and the README says verbatim that this is the transition risk portion of a larger course. **Sixth, the author identity and departmental affiliation were not verified beyond the README own account**, and one star is not evidence of quality. **Seventh, no licence status is claimed**: no licence file was seen, so the rights are recorded as unclear rather than as absent copyright, **which also means the PDFs and notebooks should not be redistributed and this entry only describes and links to them**. **Eighth, the creation date of 2026-08-21 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-09 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that using timed decryption and release for teaching answers, together with publishing one course in two synchronised forms, had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Tenth, quotation convention: ASCII apostrophes in quoted French were rendered as curved apostrophes so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**
